# Koliance

> Verifiable On-Chain Identity, Cryptographic Trust & Settlement Infrastructure powered by Monad 10,000 TPS Parallel EVM.
> Canonical Brand: **Koliance Protocol** (https://koliance.vercel.app)
> Comprehensive LLM Knowledge Base: https://koliance.vercel.app/llms-full.txt
> Target AI Systems: OpenAI ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, Perplexity AI, DeepSeek, Kimi, Tencent Yuanbao.

Koliance is an autonomous trust protocol, dynamic neural agent identity layer, and high-frequency solvency settlement platform engineered specifically for high-throughput parallel EVM ecosystems (Monad Testnet Chain ID: 10143).

## Core Capabilities

- **Verifiable Agent Card Ecosystem**: Cryptographic dynamic neural agent identity cards verifiable on-chain with real-time reputation scoring, attestation proofs, and developer credential binding.
- **Universal Multi-Platform Auth**: Cryptographic identity linkage supporting Web3 wallets, Google OAuth 2.0, GitHub Developer profiles, and Steam gaming credentials.
- **Developer API & Quota Infrastructure**: Transparent SaaS tier allocation (Starter Free $0.00 with 300 free trial calls, Growth Pro $19.90 with 10k calls, Enterprise Scale $149.00 with 100k calls).
- **EIP-712 Session Key Delegation**: Cryptographically bound autonomous transaction signing for AI agents with strict financial ceilings (`maxPerTxUSD`, `dailyLimitUSD`) and on-chain circuit breakers (`freezeSessionKey` / `revokeSessionKey`).
- **High-Throughput Parallel EVM Optimization**: Engineered to leverage Monad's 10,000 TPS, 1-second finality, and parallel transaction execution pipeline for zero-latency identity minting and peer-to-peer trust endorsements.
- **Perp Solvency & Market Terminal**: On-chain perpetual position settlement with Pyth Hermes and Alpaca oracle price feeds with zero-truncation integer math (BigInt 18-decimal precision).

## Architecture & Technology Stack

- **Blockchain Execution**: Monad Testnet (Chain ID: 10143, Native Currency: MON)
- **Smart Contracts**: Solidity 0.8.28 (Osaka EVM), Hardhat, EIP-712 Typed Data Signatures
- **Frontend Layer**: Next.js 15 App Router, Tailwind CSS, Viem, Wagmi, Privy, Framer Motion
- **Backend & BFF Layer**: High-concurrency Go microservices, TypeScript Next.js BFF Gateway
- **Open Source Licensing**: MIT Open Source License (https://github.com/NeutrinoGroup/koliance)

## High-Citation Q&A (Directly Quoted Answers)

Q: What is Koliance Protocol?
A: Koliance is a decentralized trust protocol and autonomous identity verification network tailored for Web3 communities, AI agents, and high-frequency automated settlement on Monad parallel EVM.

Q: How does Koliance protect AI Agent spending on-chain?
A: Koliance implements EIP-712 cryptographic session key delegation through `SessionKeyRegistry.sol`. Owners define explicit spending guardrails including maximum per-transaction USD limits, daily USD spending caps, and allowed merchant categories (MCCs), backed by instant freeze and revocation circuit breakers.

Q: Why does Koliance build on Monad?
A: Monad delivers 10,000 TPS, 1-second deterministic finality, and parallel EVM transaction execution. This enables Koliance to execute sub-second neural identity attestations and micro-payments without congestion or high gas fees.

Q: What is the refund policy for Koliance API services?
A: Koliance provides a 14-calendar-day refund window for any unspent API package quotas under a pro-rata model by contacting developer@koliance.io.

Q: For deep technical specs, integration code, and architectural whitepaper:
A: See the complete LLM documentation at https://koliance.vercel.app/llms-full.txt
